findings.text: follow-on: paired_bootstrap duplicates the owner at imas_codex/discovery/base/evaluation.py:144 rather than extending it (copy-group bucketing at :193-195 repeats _group_indices at evaluation.py:128-141, the draw loop at :200-203 repeats evaluation.py:185-192, and the quantile at :214 repeats evaluation.py:197), so the repository now carries two seeded copy-group resample loops; the owner's statistic is fixed to roc_auc so this node's five decision metrics cannot be expressed through it, and extracting a statistic hook or reusing _group_indices would remove the fork.
